title: Ɔkra a Wɔagye no no Akwantuo
intro: Wɔ bere a na ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow di tumi mu no, ankorankoro bi a ɔyɛ soronko nyaa nsakrae kɛse wɔ ofie a wɔahyira so mu. Wɔn asɛm a ɔdɔ hama ne ɔsoro ahyɛde ahyɛ no agyirae no kyerɛkyerɛ atetesɛm dedaw a wobu so ne nnyinasosɛm foforo a ɛteɛ a wɔde sii hɔ no mu. Saa asɛm yi si hia a nokware ho hia sen amanne kwan so ne nyansa a ɛwɔ Allah ahyɛde ahorow akyi no so dua.
clues: Bere bi na meyɛ dommum, nanso ɛdenam ɔsoro nhyehyɛe so no, minyaa ofie ne abusua foforo.
Ná wɔdɔ me araa ma bere a wɔmaa me kwan sɛ mɛpaw abusua a wɔwoo me ne nea ɔhwɛɛ me sɛ ne ba no, mepaw sɛ mɛtra nea otwa to no nkyɛn.
Bere bi na wɔde me din bata ɔhwɛfo a wagye me ayɛ ne ba no ho, adeyɛ a na abu so wɔ me man mu.
Me nko ara ne Ɔkɔmhyɛni a ɔtwa toɔ a Allah abɔ ne din pefee wɔ Kur’aan mu no hokafoɔ.
Mewaree ɔbaa anuonyam bi a na ɔyɛ Ɔkɔmhyɛni no wɔfase, nanso yɛn awareɛ no ankyɛ.
Me awaregyaeɛ akyi no, Allah ankasa hyɛɛ sɛ me kan yere no bɛware Ɔkɔmhyɛni no, na ɛnam so ama tete amanne bi a ɛfa mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma ho no yɛɛ kwa.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
